annotations.title: List coming plenary and committee votes

description: Use this when the user asks what the European Parliament or a committee will vote on soon, e.g. "what is on the plenary agenda next week" or "which committee votes are planned on 11 November". Returns the plenary and committee votes from today for up to 14 days, soonest first, each with date, time (Brussels), body (PLEN or committee code), procedure reference, title, a state and an epvotes.com url. The state is "not held yet", "scheduled time passed, result not published" or "result published" (with the result). An agenda is a plan that can change until the day: a vote counts as held only when a result is stored. A vote today with no time stays "not held yet" for the whole day. Use list_votes for votes already held.

body.description: Keep only plenary votes or only committee votes (default all).

committee.description: Keep only the votes of one committee, e.g. "ENVI" (joint meetings with that committee are included).

days.description: How many days from today to look ahead (default 14).

name: list_upcoming_votes
